title: Parse coupon codes into discounts
requirement: Add a parseCoupon(code) function, exported from src/index.ts, that turns a coupon code into a Discount. SAVE<n> means n percent off, with n from 1 to 100. TAKE<n> means n whole currency units off (TAKE5 is 500 cents), with n of at least 1 and at most four digits. Codes are case-insensitive and surrounding whitespace is ignored. Any other code, including an out-of-range number, throws a RangeError. The result must be usable as the discount option of totals().
